comment: The toolchains of json that no other file declares. npm is declared in the devEngines.packageManager of package.json, Rust in rust-toolchain.toml and PHP in .php-version; phpExtension names the PHP minors for which a release builds the PHP extension. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (the Node.js, the Go and the Python of the kit pins with uv, alint of make layout-check, ruff, vulture, golangci-lint and deadcode of the lints, cargo-audit and govulncheck, and Composer) and mise.lock locks them. symbolExtractors names the PHP programs of kit that lint-php reads.

llvm.reason: the major release of the LLVM whose libclang and clang the bindgen of ext-php-rs uses in make release-php-ext of packages/release.mk (binding GN-19d, GN-19h): clang-sys takes the libclang of the highest LLVM that it finds and bindgen asks the clang of PATH for its headers, so the two differ on a machine with several LLVM releases, and the ubuntu-26.04 runners hold LLVM 20, 21 and 22 with clang 21 as /usr/bin/clang. no recipe installs it: the ubuntu-26.04 images hold it at /usr/lib/llvm-<major>, the default LLVM_ROOT of the recipe, and the macOS job of .github/workflows/assets.yml installs it with install-llvm-action (whose version names this major) and passes its LLVM_PATH as LLVM_ROOT
llvm.removal: when the build of the PHP extension no longer runs bindgen, or a release of ext-php-rs no longer reads the libclang of the machine

phpExtension.reason: the PHP minors for which a release builds the PHP extension of packages/php-ext on each platform (.github/workflows/assets.yml): a build of the extension loads only in the PHP minor that built it, and packages/php-ext/composer.json requires PHP >=8.4, so the list starts at that lower bound and names every stable minor after it; a new stable PHP minor is added here and in assets.yml
